Quick findings from my side: I've pulled their trial activity and auth events (attached snippet). There are three suspicious indicators: repeated top-up requests from two different billing emails that both map to the same company domain, overlapping API keys created within a 24-hour window, and a burst pattern consistent with scripted load tests (steady short bursts ~2–3 minutes every 10 minutes). Not conclusive evidence of fraud, but it flags for policy review.

My recommendation: deny an open-ended extension. Offer a controlled one-week sandbox top-up with token limits and IP/KV caching disabled so we can monitor for repeated attempts. Require a signed pilot statement and billing contact verification before enabling.
